fees.label: Certificate of Occupancy application (resale, rental or annual; 2021 form)
fees.quote: $75.00 Rental and Certificate of Occupancy Application

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Borough "Application for Certificate of Occupancy Pursuant to Ordinance" (check RESALE, give the settlement date, buyer and agents), sign it as the current owner and return it to Borough Hall, 18 Catawba Avenue (mail to PO Box 856, Newfield, NJ 08344) with the fee. Call the Construction Office to schedule. The Construction Official keeps office hours Wednesday 3:00 pm to 5:00 pm.

resale_co.notes: Round 3: the live site still shows a bot check, so Internet Archive copies of official Borough files were used. The Borough form "Application for Certificate of Occupancy Pursuant to Ordinance" (original https://www.newfieldborough.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/07/Certificate-of-Occupancy.pdf, scanned, captured 2021-07-31) has RESALE, ANNUAL and TENANT CHANGE boxes, a settlement date line and fees of $75.00 (application) and $30.00 (re-inspection). The Borough Forms page captured 2026-06-15 still links this same 2021 file as the "Certificate of Occupancy form for applicable property transactions". Status is set to required because the Borough's own form says the CO is issued pursuant to ordinance and covers resales; the ordinance text itself was not read (ecode360). An older 2018 version of the form (original http://www.newfieldborough.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/04/Application-for-Occupancy.pdf) showed $50.00 application and $25.00 re-inspection fees and also required septic and termite certification before a C/O; the 2021 form mentions only the well certification. Contact details come from the Borough Contact page captured 2026-05-16 (original https://www.newfieldborough.org/contact-us/). The Borough's May 2024 inspection request form has dphyder@newfieldboro.org written in by hand on a Northfield template, and the Borough contact page lists no email, so no email is shown to agents. Lead time and validity were not stated.

authorities.name: Gloucester County Fire Marshal's Office (county local enforcing agency for the Uniform Fire Code)
authorities.how_to_apply: The state directory lists the Newfield Borough Construction Office (18 Catawba Ave, 856-697-1100) as the smoke detector compliance contact, so start with the Borough. The County Fire Marshal's Office is the fire code enforcing agency.

fire_cert.notes: The DCA LEA Registry (July 2026) lists Newfield as C (County) and the Gloucester County Fire Marshal page lists Newfield among its LEA towns. The state fire directory (survey 6/16/2026) names "Newfield Boro Constr" (18 Catawba Av, (856) 697-1100) in the smoke detector compliance column, so the Borough Construction Office appears to handle smoke/CO certification for sales, probably within the resale CO inspection (N.J.A.C. 5:70-2.3 lets a municipal resale inspection stand in for the separate certificate). No separate smoke certificate fee was found. The type list has no county option, so the county entry is "unknown".
